name: Pawns
blurb: Pawns is a feature-rich chess application that lets you play against Stockfish engine, challenge friends in local or remote p2p play, create custom scenarios, and analyze games.
description:
Pawns is a feature-rich chess application that lets you play against Stockfish engine,
challenge friends in local or remote p2p play, create custom scenarios, and analyze games.

Game Modes:

• Human vs Human - Play with a friend on the same computer

• Human vs Engine - Challenge Stockfish at adjustable difficulty (0-20)

• Engine vs Engine (E2E) - Watch two chess engines battle it out

• Remote Play (P2P) - Play against a friend over the network with SSL encryption

Visual Customization:

• Multiple piece sets (Celtic, Fantasy, Eyes, Skulls, Spatial, and more)

• Board color themes (Classic, Wood, Green, Blue, Gray, Brown)

• Customizable background color behind the board

• Zoom with Ctrl+Mouse Wheel

• Toggle board markings (rank and file labels)

Time Controls:

• Customizable time controls (1-60 minutes)

• Increment options (0-30 seconds)

• Visual clock display with progress bars

• Time-out detection (flag falls)

• Clock synchronization in remote play

Tools:

• Scenario Builder - Create and save custom board positions

• Save and Load games in .chess format (full state with clocks and difficulty)

• PGN export for sharing games

• Move history with table view in the dock

• Game replay with media-style controls

• Console for engine output and UCI commands

Remote Play:

• SSL-encrypted P2P connection

• Contact list with IP/port storage

• In-game chat

• DTLS encrypted push-to-talk audio

• LAN peer discovery via UDP broadcast

• UPnP port forwarding support

• Resign, draw offer, and stop game functionality

Engine Support:

• Stockfish engine with Skill Level control (0-20)

• GNU Chess engine support (XBoard mode)

• Move validation and position analysis

• Checkmate, stalemate, and draw detection

Audio Feedback:

• Move sounds

• Check notification

• Checkmate sound

• Toggle sound on/off
